info.description: Every route needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (ADR-013). Every mutation of an existing resource needs `If-Match` with the ETag last read (ADR-009): absent is 428, stale is 412. Every error is `application/problem+json` with a stable `type` = `urn:ai-company-os:problem:<slug>` (ADR-007); branch on `type`, not on `title`.
info.title: AI Company OS — control plane
